name: labelObject
signature: int labelObject(QString text, QString objectName, bool visible, float fontSize, QString fontColor, QString side, double labelDistance, QString style, bool autoDelete, int autoDeleteTimeoutMs)
description: Creates a text label attached to a celestial object (star, planet, galaxy, constellation, etc.) using an HTML-like color string. The label follows the object as it moves across the sky and can be positioned relative to the object with an optional connection line. This overload converts the color string to Vec3f internally and forwards to the Vec3f variant.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text content to display as the label

parameters.name: objectName
parameters.description: English name of the celestial object to attach the label to (e.g., 'Mars', 'Sirius', 'Andromeda Galaxy', 'Orion')

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: If true, the label starts visible; if false, starts hidden

parameters.name: fontSize
parameters.description: Font size in pixels

parameters.name: fontColor
parameters.description: HTML-like color specification (e.g., '#ffff00' for yellow) or '#RRGGBB'

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Position relative to object: 'N' (above), 'S' (below), 'E' (right), 'W' (left), 'NE', 'NW', 'SE', 'SW', or 'C' (centered)

parameters.name: labelDistance
parameters.description: Distance offset from object in pixels (negative or -1 for automatic placement based on object size)

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Label style: 'TextOnly' or 'Line' (draws a line from text to object)

parameters.name: autoDelete
parameters.description: If true, the label is automatically deleted after being displayed once

parameters.name: autoDeleteTimeoutMs
parameters.description: If non-zero, automatically deletes the label after this many milliseconds

returnDescription: Unique label ID, or -1 if the object was not found

name: labelObject
signature: int labelObject(QString text, QString objectName, bool visible, float fontSize, Vec3f fontColor, QString side, double labelDistance, QString style, bool autoDelete, int autoDeleteTimeoutMs)
description: Creates a text label attached to a celestial object using a Vec3f color vector. The label follows the object as it moves across the sky. This is the base overload; the QString-color variant forwards to it.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text content to display as the label

parameters.name: objectName
parameters.description: English name of the celestial object to attach the label to

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: If true, the label starts visible; if false, starts hidden

parameters.name: fontSize
parameters.description: Font size in pixels

parameters.name: fontColor
parameters.description: RGB color vector (R, G, B) with values between 0.0 and 1.0

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Position relative to object: 'N', 'S', 'E', 'W', 'NE', 'NW', 'SE', 'SW', or 'C'

parameters.name: labelDistance
parameters.description: Distance offset from object in pixels (-1 for automatic)

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Label style: 'TextOnly' or 'Line'

parameters.name: autoDelete
parameters.description: If true, the label is automatically deleted after being displayed once

parameters.name: autoDeleteTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Auto-delete timeout in milliseconds

returnDescription: Unique label ID, or -1 if the object was not found

name: labelHorizon
signature: int labelHorizon(QString text, float az, float alt, bool visible, float fontSize, QString fontColor, bool autoDelete, int autoDeleteTimeoutMs)
description: Creates a text label fixed to a specific Altitude/Azimuth (horizontal) coordinate using an HTML-like color string. The label stays at that compass direction and altitude as the sky rotates, useful for marking landscape features or cardinal directions. This overload converts the color string to Vec3f internally.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text content to display as the label

parameters.name: az
parameters.description: Azimuth angle in degrees (0 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West)

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Altitude angle in degrees (0 = horizon, 90 = zenith)

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: If true, the label starts visible; if false, starts hidden

parameters.name: fontSize
parameters.description: Font size in pixels

parameters.name: fontColor
parameters.description: HTML-like color specification (e.g., '#00ff00' for green)

parameters.name: autoDelete
parameters.description: If true, the label is automatically deleted after being displayed once

parameters.name: autoDeleteTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Auto-delete timeout in milliseconds

returnDescription: Unique label ID, or -1 if creation failed

compatibility.notes: Horizon labels introduced around Stellarium 0.14/0.15; verify exact version

name: labelEquatorial
signature: int labelEquatorial(QString text, QString ra, QString dec, bool visible, float fontSize, QString fontColor, QString side, double labelDistance, bool autoDelete, int autoDeleteTimeoutMs, bool j2000epoch)
description: Creates a text label fixed to a specific Equatorial coordinate (Right Ascension/Declination) using an HTML-like color string. Useful for marking deep-sky object positions or celestial coordinates that stay fixed relative to the stars. The ra and dec strings are parsed by StelUtils::getDecAngle and accept hms/dms forms such as '5h10m31s' and '25d30m30s'. This overload converts the color string to Vec3f internally.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text content to display as the label

parameters.name: ra
parameters.description: Right Ascension as a string (e.g., '5h10m31s', '2h30m')

parameters.name: dec
parameters.description: Declination as a string (e.g., '25d30m30s', '-45d', '+30d15m')

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: If true, the label starts visible; if false, starts hidden

parameters.name: fontSize
parameters.description: Font size in pixels

parameters.name: fontColor
parameters.description: HTML-like color specification (e.g., '#ffaa00')

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Position relative to coordinate point: 'N', 'S', 'E', 'W', 'NE', 'NW', 'SE', 'SW', or 'C'

parameters.name: labelDistance
parameters.description: Distance offset in pixels (-1 for automatic)

parameters.name: autoDelete
parameters.description: If true, automatically deleted after display

parameters.name: autoDeleteTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Auto-delete timeout in milliseconds

parameters.name: j2000epoch
parameters.description: If true, coordinates are treated as J2000.0 epoch; if false, as current date coordinates

returnDescription: Unique label ID, or -1 if creation failed

name: labelScreen
signature: int labelScreen(QString text, int x, int y, bool visible, float fontSize, QString fontColor, bool autoDelete, int autoDeleteTimeoutMs)
description: Creates a text label fixed to a specific pixel position on the screen using an HTML-like color string. The label stays at the same screen coordinates regardless of sky movement, useful for UI messages, headers, or status displays. The y coordinate is measured from the top edge of the screen. This overload converts the color string to Vec3f internally.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text content to display as the label

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X coordinate in pixels from the left edge of the screen

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y coordinate in pixels from the top edge of the screen

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: If true, the label starts visible; if false, starts hidden

parameters.name: fontSize
parameters.description: Font size in pixels

parameters.name: fontColor
parameters.description: HTML-like color specification (e.g., '#ffffff' for white)

parameters.name: autoDelete
parameters.description: If true, the label is automatically deleted after being displayed once

parameters.name: autoDeleteTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Auto-delete timeout in milliseconds

returnDescription: Unique label ID, or -1 if creation failed

name: getLabelShow
description: Returns whether a label is currently visible (shown) or hidden. Returns false if the label ID does not exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique label ID returned by one of the label creation functions

returnDescription: true if the label is visible, false if hidden or label does not exist

name: setLabelShow
description: Shows or hides an existing label by its ID. The label fades in/out smoothly. Silently ignored if the ID does not exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique label ID returned by one of the label creation functions

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: true to show the label, false to hide it

name: setLabelText
description: Changes the text content of an existing label. Useful for updating status messages, counters, or dynamic information without creating a new label. Silently ignored if the ID does not exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique label ID returned by one of the label creation functions

parameters.name: newText
parameters.description: The new text to display in the label

name: deleteLabel
description: Permanently deletes a label by its ID. The label is removed from memory and will no longer be displayed. Silently ignored if the ID does not exist. Useful for cleaning up labels that are no longer needed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique label ID returned by one of the label creation functions

returnDescription: none; silently ignored if the ID does not exist

name: deleteAllLabels
description: Deletes all custom labels created by the script. Returns the number of labels that were deleted. Useful for cleaning up at the end of a presentation or script.
